title: BenQ E55-750 (55" 4K, Taiwan), Google TV on Android 11 (SDK 30), firmware RTM8.240401.136
notes:
BenQ E55-750 (55" 4K, Taiwan), Google TV on Android 11 (SDK 30), firmware RTM8.240401.136
Built by Changhong (ro.product.model="AI PONT", product DVB96BQ, board m7632), MediaTek, about 1.8 GB
RAM. Same product name as the E55-735 example but an older, Android 11 based firmware.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/benq-e55-750/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/benq-e55-750/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx. Already disabled from the factory:
com.google.android.marvin.talkback. No ACR package (tv.anoki.*) on this firmware.

Quirks on this firmware, checked on the TV:
- USB debugging alone opens port 5555; there is no Wireless debugging toggle.
- HOME candidates: launcherx (priority 2), setupwraith/.RecoveryActivity (priority 1), so disable
setupwraith first, then run launcher/build-and-install.sh.
- The default screensaver is dreamx's Backdrop (ambient mode). Point it at the launcher's clock
before disabling dreamx:
settings put secure screensaver_components com.gathin.tvhome/.ClockDream
settings put secure screensaver_default_component com.gathin.tvhome/.ClockDream
restore.sh does not undo either; the stock value of both is com.google.android.apps.tv.dreamx/.service.Backdrop
Changhong / Homwee store and help
